latest_release.name: v13.6.0
latest_release.body:
# 13.6.0 (2026-10-27)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/compare/v13.5.0...v13.6.0)

We expect this release to ship in the DevTools of [Chrome 159](https://chromiumdash.appspot.com/schedule), and to PageSpeed Insights within a week.

## New contributors

Thanks to our new contributors 👽🐷🐰🐯🐻!

- Nikolay Vitkov @Lightning00Blade
- MohammadHossein Jahanbakhsh @MHJahanbakhsh
- Rafe Blandford @rafeblandford
- Roman @gameroman
- Ivan Akulov @iamakulov
- Francesco Marinoni Moretto @frmoretto

## Notable Changes

* **CLI bulk URL auditing**: The CLI now supports auditing multiple URLs sequentially in a single command—either by passing multiple URL arguments or via `--url-file` (with `--fail-fast` to abort on the first failure) ([#17404](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17404)). Default report filenames now include the URL pathname (`<hostname>-<pathname>_<date>`) to avoid collisions across pages on the same host ([#17405](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17405), [#17423](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17423)).
* **Lantern simulation improvements**: Upgraded `trace_engine` (`0.0.66` and `0.0.67`) and updated request/graph modeling to improve simulation accuracy ([#17307](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17307), [#17379](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17379)):
  * **Network & protocol modeling**: Treated HTTP/3 connections as multiplexed, credited consumed H2 overflow bytes across simulation steps, excluded connectionless requests from active connection counts, and improved origin RTT/throughput estimation and redirect handling ([#17415](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17415)).
  * **Dependency graph & metrics**: Added `v8.compileModule` and `v8.evaluateModule` trace event attribution, used protocol `renderBlocking` status for render-blocking priority ([#16869](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/16869)), used FCP graphs when text LCP occurs in the same frame as FCP, and fixed simulated LCP breakdown calculations ([#17269](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17269)) and trace-mode navigation/URL handling ([#17431](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17431), [#17433](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17433)).
* **Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.91**: Updated the `ard-schema` audit and gatherer to the ARD v0.91 specification (`ard.json` replacing `ai-catalog.json`), supporting discovery via `Link` HTTP headers, `<link rel="ard">`, and `/.well-known/ard.json`, warning on legacy `ai-catalog` locations, and displaying the ARD spec version in the report footer ([#17258](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17258), [#17259](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17259), [#17260](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17260), [#17448](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17448), [#17452](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17452)).
* **Performance insight `numericValue`**: Performance insight audits now populate `numericValue` and `numericUnit` from estimated time or byte savings ([#17346](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17346)), and select the correct navigation when traces contain multiple navigations ([#17174](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17174)).
* **Memory and gathering optimizations**: Reduced peak memory usage during runs by streaming traces (`ReturnAsStream`), reusing script sources from trace events, evicting decoded frame buffers in `speedline`, and releasing intermediate gatherer and trace engine state ([#17286](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17286), [#17289](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17289), [#17290](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17290), [#17407](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/pull/17407)).
